## Report

The 12 errors are pre-existing `local_only` live-session tests (3 in W1-25, 9 in W1-49) that need `api.anthropic.com` — blocked by the sandbox. They are unrelated to DEC-444.

| 8 | `TestCheckpointReinjection` | `test_injection_says_which_path` | `record.brief()` does not report which path the checkpoint came from |

### Revised cases (6) with reasons

| # | Class | Test | Revision | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `TestPreCompact` | `test_writes_checkpoint` | Assert checkpoint under `.gov-runtime/scratch/checkpoints/` instead of `docs/checkpoints/`; assert nothing new under `docs/checkpoints/` | **RED** — `record.write()` still uses `docs/checkpoints/` |
| 2 | `TestStop` | `test_writes_checkpoint` | Same pattern | **RED** — same reason |
| 3 | `TestCheckpointOnContextUtilisation` | `test_stop_writes_checkpoint_not_only_precompact` | Assert checkpoint under scratch dir | **RED** — same reason |
| 4 | `TestStop` | `test_no_checkpoint_without_ticket` | Now checks both `docs/checkpoints/` AND `.gov-runtime/scratch/checkpoints/` for nothing written | **GREEN** — no checkpoint was written (no change in observable behaviour) |
| 5 | `TestStop` | `test_respects_stop_hook_active` | Checks scratch dir for no changes | **GREEN** — hook is suppressed, nothing written anywhere |
| 6 | `TestNoStopLoop` | `test_stop_exits_without_side_effects_when_active` | Checks scratch dir for no changes | **GREEN** — hook exits early, nothing written |

**3 red, 3 green.**

### What the specification left open

1. **Record-id collision detection across locations**: DEC-444 says ids must be unique per ticket across both `docs/checkpoints/<ticket>/` and `.gov-runtime/scratch/checkpoints/<ticket>/`. It does not say which function owns this check — `record.write()` must read both directories before minting an id, but the decision text does not specify what happens on a collision (error? skip? increment suffix?). The test asserts uniqueness but does not prescribe the error path.

2. **Path label format in the SessionStart injection**: DEC-444 says SessionStart must "say which path it came from". The test checks that the output contains either `docs/checkpoints` or `.gov-runtime/scratch/checkpoints` as a substring, but the exact phrasing/format of that attribution is not specified. The implementation may choose any format that contains the path.

3. **Migration of existing automatic checkpoints**: DEC-444 does not say whether existing automatic checkpoints already in `docs/checkpoints/` should be moved to the scratch location, or only new ones go there. The tests assume forward-only (new writes go to scratch; existing records in `docs/` are still readable by SessionStart and watchdog).

4. **Scratch directory creation**: DEC-444 does not say who creates `.gov-runtime/scratch/checkpoints/<ticket>/` — the hook or `record.write()`. The tests only assert the directory exists after the hook runs and contains the record.
